imageeditor.net.http_status: 301 to https://www.imageeditor.net/ then 200 OK (WordPress site still live)

analysis.clientRenewProhibited_explanation: This flag means the registrant or registrar has explicitly blocked renewal. On GoDaddy, this typically happens when: (1) the domain is part of a legal dispute/UDRP, (2) the registrant requested deletion, (3) there is a billing issue. Combined with clientDeleteProhibited, this is contradictory — it cannot be renewed but also cannot be deleted. This usually means a dispute or administrative hold.
analysis.all_four_locks: All four client-side locks are set (delete, renew, transfer, update). This is unusual and suggests GoDaddy has placed an administrative lock. Could be UDRP, fraud investigation, or legal hold.
analysis.still_serving_content: The site is still serving a live WordPress site at www.imageeditor.net, which suggests the hosting is still paid even though the domain is locked.
analysis.estimated_drop_timeline: Expiry: 2026-09-20. With clientRenewProhibited, the domain CANNOT be renewed. If the lock is not removed before expiry, it will enter GoDaddy's auction or drop process. GoDaddy expired domains: 18-day auction period, then 12-day grace, then drop. Estimated drop: ~November 2026 if not resolved.
analysis.risk: The clientRenewProhibited lock could be removed at any time if the underlying dispute is resolved. Also, GoDaddy often sends expired premium domains to GoDaddy Auctions before dropping them to the general pool.

dropcatch.notes: DropCatch has excellent .net catch rates since .net is Verisign registry (same as .com).

godaddy_auctions.notes: IMPORTANT: Since this domain is on GoDaddy with clientRenewProhibited, GoDaddy may route it through their own expired domain auction before it drops to the general pool. Monitor GoDaddy Auctions starting ~September 2026.
